title: Return
drDigitalIntro:
Return (also called Enter) starts a new line — like pressing Return at the end of a paragraph.
• In a document or notes app, it moves the cursor to the next line.
• In a form or dialog box, it means OK or Submit.
• Warning: in some chat apps, Return sends your message immediately! Look before you press.
• Find it on the right side of your keyboard — it is one of the largest keys.

playgroundTask.instructions: Type this two-line note exactly — you will need to press Return between the lines.
playgroundTask.targetText:
Dear Dr. Digital,
Thank you for teaching me!

drDigitalSuccess: You used Return to start a new line — that is exactly how paragraphs and new lines work everywhere.
drDigitalHint: Type the first line, then press Return (or Enter) to move down, then type the second line.
